title: Write src/farewell.txt
body:
## Goal
Create the file `src/farewell.txt` containing exactly one line: `goodbye after iteration 14`. Iteration 14 is the iteration in which `src/greeting.txt` was merged (task 297, record `iterations/0014.json`). Create nothing else. Do not fix anything outside this file.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/farewell.txt` exists and its content is exactly `goodbye after iteration 14` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed
## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/farewell.txt').read() != 'goodbye after iteration 14\n')"`
## Context
- goal: `.session/loop-state.json` field `goal.text`
- merge iteration: `iterations/0014.json` (task `greeting`, issue 297, merged, iteration closed)
## Budget
- `src/farewell.txt` (new file)
